summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  **What I found from reading the code (no edits made):** I traced the full path — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → DB — and it looks correctly wired end-to-end: - Client uses one shared `api` client with `credentials: "include"` on every call; no localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist page (only unrelated theme state uses localStorage). - Server-side, `watchlistRouter.use("*", ...)` requires a valid `arca_session` cookie on every route, resolves it to a real use
